name: Battle

components.pose: She stands with her sunburst staff raised to the sky in one hand and the other palm open, chin lifted, a calm, radiant gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.jewelry: a white-gold sunburst gorget with {{GEM}} stones, gleaming bracers
components.effects: A column of golden light descends on her from the clouds, beams of {{MAGIC}} radiance sweeping the field and driving back the smoke, wounded soldiers behind her rising into the glow.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
